messages:
mike: CI microbench alert: pr#19999 shows +6.2% p99 latency on the kernel-selection path vs base. Threshold diff flagged it as a regression.
laura: dashboard -> https://perf.internal/redwood/pr/19999 :eyes:
mike: repro'd locally with --bench micro_kernel_select; looks like the selector flips kernels more often on seq_len distribution we use.
anika: can you paste the flamegraph or top stack?
mike: here (trimmed):
```
  flamegraph.svg
  ├─ choose_kernel
  │  ├─ cost_model::score
  │  │  ├─ compute_attention_kernels
  │  │  └─ kv_cache::lookup
  │  └─ compare_costs
  └─ batcher::enqueue
```
kevin: bisect points at commit ab4e1c2 (PR #19844) — changed autoselect beta and warmup policy.
mike: I tried reverting ab4e1c2 locally; microbench p99 returns to baseline. Revert diff: https://git.internal/r/redwood/commit/ab4e1c2/revert (local test).
ci-bot: PR 19999 marked rollout-blocker: perf regression detected by microbench CI.
laura: :eyes: We need a patch that avoids oscillation. Could also hot-revert if needed.
anika: I'll prototype a clamp + hysteresis in kernel_selector: keep a hysteresis window of 3 decisions and clamp beta to >=0.6. Will run shadow bench.
mike: also noticed KV hit-rate drops ~3% in the failing runs — suggests selector picks kernel variant that hurts cache locality during warmup.
kevin: batcher timer jitter increased too; the kernel change seems to push some workloads into the coldpath more often. Putting a canary on a dedicated pool to confirm.
mike: immediate mitigation plan: 1) revert ab4e1c2 on canary 2) add unit test for kernel-cost monotonicity 3) add feature flag to adjust beta without deploy.
laura: opened revert PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pull/19999-revert-19844 — CI queued.
ci-bot: CI update: microbench unit failing on kernel_cost_model_test::monotonicity (flaky exposed by revert).
mike: taking the test. Reproducer: ./tools/perf_micro --seed=42 --seq-len=128 --iters=200; attach perf.data.
anika: pushed local probe that clamps beta and adds hysteresis, plus an integration bench run: p99 drop to +0.8% (within threshold). Will open PR.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy of reverted commit scheduled: staging at 2026-03-20T15:22Z (ID: canary-19999).
laura: if canary looks good we'll roll back the upstream merge and promote a release candidate.
kevin: notes from bisect: effective_cost = raw + beta * kv_miss_penalty; ab4e1c2 changed beta 0.8 -> 0.45 and removed hysteresis. That reduction made the selector too sensitive to transient kv misses.
mike: agree. Proposed: clamp beta >= 0.6 and add hysteresis window = 3 decisions; add kernel-cost monotonicity unit test. Oscillation disappears in my local runs.
anika: PR ready: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pull/20011 (clamp + hysteresis + test). Running CI microbench.
mike: :thumbsup: thanks. Keeping this thread as the perf artifact tracker — please paste any additional bench outputs here.
ci-bot: Thread status: open — blocking until PR 20011 lands and CI microbench passes.
